title: A skin package's skin.json
description: The file inside a skin package that says how one plugin's panel is drawn. The package is a directory named after the plugin id; this file overrides what the panel description gives (its sections, labels, roles, displays) and names the art and the view the skin brings. It restates no range, unit or scale: the plugin's own description holds those and the skin refers to controls by id.

floor.description: A floor: ">=" and a three-part version. No ceiling and no exact pin is accepted.

requires.description: What a reader must provide to read this file, each as a floor (">= MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH"), never a ceiling. "omx-skins-schema" is the version of this schema the file was written for. A file with no requires, or none for the schema, is refused.

plugin.description: The id of the plugin this skin draws: a CLAP id or an LV2 URI.

licence.description: The SPDX identifier of the licence the skin is under. Which identifiers are allowed is the loader's rule, not this schema's.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the plugin description the skin was made against.

family.description: The panel family the skin draws the plugin as.

roles.description: Control id to the role a skin binds it by.

labels.description: Control id to the label the skin shows.

visibleWhen.description: Control id to the control and values that make it visible.

displays.description: The displays the panel draws: each names its kind and what feeds it.

houseView.description: The family of the house view to use in place of a view of the skin's own.

backdrop.description: A file under the package's art/ directory.

view.description: A view of the skin's own: its entry file under view/, and the skin API version it was written for (MAJOR.MINOR).
